title: Python: Node Handoff oracle implementation
description:
Python oracle for GCP-7 Node Handoff: DAO to new gateway, POST /handoff protocol, state transfer (sequence numbers, security contexts), route update simulation.

## MUST/SHALL Checklist (from spec/08-gateway-coordination.md)

### GCP-7 Node Handoff Protocol (procedural requirements)
- [ ] Node sends DAO to new Gateway B when moving (detected via better parent/RSSI)
- [ ] Gateway B sends POST /handoff to Gateway A (via backbone) with node details
- [ ] Gateway A releases node from its registry and sends confirmation
- [ ] Gateway B confirms handoff to node via CoAP
- [ ] Routes updated in RPL DODAG

### State Transfer Requirements
- [ ] Recent sequence numbers transferred (DAO, path sequence)
- [ ] Security contexts transferred if applicable (OSCORE parameters)
- [ ] Node IPv6 address included
- [ ] Replay windows transferred

### Security Requirements (GCP-9, applied to handoff)
- [ ] Handoff messages MUST be authenticated via OSCORE (PSK for closed, signatures for open federation)
- [ ] Handoff messages MUST be encrypted (OSCORE)
- [ ] Replay protection via sequence numbers and timestamps
- [ ] Rate limiting on CoAP endpoints to prevent DoS

### Sequence Number Safety (derived from GCP-7 state transfer)
- [ ] Sequence numbers MUST be transferred accurately
- [ ] Receiving gateway MUST use sequence number strictly greater than transferred value (prevent replay of in-flight messages)
- [ ] OSCORE sender sequence MUST be incremented on accept (prevent nonce reuse)

### Federation Mode Support (GCP-3, GCP-10)
- [ ] MUST support PSK mode (closed federation) for handoff
- [ ] MUST support signature mode (open federation) for handoff

### Error Cases (derived from protocol)
- [ ] NODE_NOT_FOUND: node not in source gateway registry
- [ ] NODE_BUSY: node in active communication (retry later)
- [ ] AUTH_FAILED: OSCORE verification failed
- [ ] MALFORMED_REQUEST: invalid CBOR or missing fields
- [ ] RATE_LIMITED: too many handoff requests
